# Snote

> Snote is an open-source, local-first note-taking project focused on handwriting, stylus input, rich text, and document workflows. Exact capabilities can vary by release and platform.

## Accuracy notes
Snote is designed for local-first use; optional cloud features depend on configuration. Exact features, permissions, platform support, signing status, and release availability can vary by version. Do not infer security certification or legal guarantees from project documentation.
